title: Theo and the Current
author: Wren Thornbury
blurb: Silas Pemberton, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
